paper.title: Algorithm 698: DCUHRE, an adaptive multidimensional integration routine for a vector of integrals
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 17(4), December 1991, pp. 452-456 (archive header: VOL. 17, NO. 4, DECEMBER 1991, PP. 452-456)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 698.gz (scouted 2026-11-27, gz sha256 27d891c14cabaefddd7c9cd6d3a6a2ae5b60eafa70901c32914f019363fda501). Shell archive (GNU sharutils 4.1) with READ.ME, makefile, dtest1.f, dtest2.f, dcuhre.f and the other double-precision and single-precision routines; extract with sh into a fresh directory.

claim.location: Inside 698.gz, the member dtest1.f, its header comment block (the lines after 'DTEST1 is a simple test driver for DCUHRE', headed 'Output produced on a SUN 3/50' and 'DCUHRE TEST RESULTS'; about lines 1-10 of the extracted dtest1.f). It is the printed output of the driver dtest1.f: 5-dimensional integral over the unit cube of F(z)=exp(-sum_n n z_n^2/2) (FTEST in dtest1.f), with ABSREQ=0, RELREQ=1E-3, MINCLS=0, MAXCLS=10000, KEY=0, NW=5000.

reference.file: dtest1.f inside 698.gz (header comment, SUN 3/50 output block)
reference.sha256: not recorded for the extracted dtest1.f; the archive sha256 is 27d891c14cabaefddd7c9cd6d3a6a2ae5b60eafa70901c32914f019363fda501

claim.metric: The integral column of the DTEST1 table, components 1 to 6: 0.13850818, 0.06369469, 0.05861748, 0.05407034, 0.05005614, 0.04654608 (the integral of F and of z_n F over the unit cube). The count FTEST CALLS = 3549 and IFAIL = 0 must also match exactly (integers).
claim.paper_value: Not checked against the paper; the archive's printed sample output is the value to check.

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The printed values have 8 decimals, so rounding is 5e-9. Different libm or compiler rounding changes the last bits, far below 1e-7. A different adaptive subdivision path changes the integrals by about the estimated errors printed alongside, up to 8.7e-6, so 1e-7 separates a rounding difference from a changed path. CALLS and IFAIL are integers and must match exactly. Not loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute for DTEST1 (3549 integrand calls in 5 dimensions).
cost.data_size: Archive 698.gz about 6053 lines; no data files.
cost.data_licence: Not stated in the archive; a Collected Algorithm from ACM TOMS. The rerun should record the licence it finds.

why: The archive ships a Fortran driver and its printed output of a 5-dimensional adaptive integral, so the integrals and the call count can be compared to 1e-7 without the paper's tables.
